title: Data-centre migration
goal: Show readiness, sequential migration waves, business sign-off, and cutover dependencies.

rubric.must: Pilot validation visibly precedes a sequential Wave 1, Wave 2, and Wave 3 migration chain.
Cutover visibly waits for both Wave 3 migration and business-readiness sign-off.
The pilot visibly depends on both target-platform provisioning and backup validation.
Decommission legacy visibly follows the cutover milestone.
Migration kickoff, business readiness sign-off, and cutover are visibly distinguished as milestones.
A critical path is visibly highlighted through the migration schedule.
